headline: Independent Nomination Board

meeting.summary: The board met in closed session on an applicant's eligibility and heard the County Council passed, on first reading, an amendment to dissolve it.
meeting.recap: The Independent Nomination Board met July 13, 2026, with five members present and one excused.[[0:00:30]] Members at the pineapple festival passed out flyers but received no applications.[[0:02:34]] Three members, including the chair, serve on the corporation counsel investigative group (a small fact-finding team).[[0:12:35]] That group's report to the full board is tentatively set for the August 12 or August 26 meeting.[[0:13:09]] The board was told its practical charter deadline is Friday, October 2.[[0:13:38]] The board voted 5–0 to go into executive session (a closed-door meeting) to discuss one applicant's eligibility with its attorney.[[0:17:03]] On attorney advice, one member was recused (stepped aside) from the corporation counsel selection.[[0:19:29]] Staff reported the County Council passed, on first reading, a charter amendment to dissolve the Independent Nomination Board.[[0:25:37]] It needs two readings with at least six council votes to reach the ballot.[[0:26:43]] Members said sending someone to the second reading was not worth their time.[[0:27:06]] The amendment would still need voter approval at the November general election.[[0:28:52]] The July 22 meeting is canceled.[[0:30:32]] The corporation counsel group is ready; the prosecuting attorney group is not.[[0:32:45]] The board will meet August 12 and August 26.[[0:36:27]]
decided: boards and commissions liaison report: The boards and commissions liaison report was deferred because it was not ready.
The board voted to go into executive session to consult its attorney about one applicant's eligibility.
After the closed session, the chair said one member was recused from the corporation counsel selection on attorney advice.
Members agreed there will be no meeting on July 22.
Members agreed to lock in August 12 for the next meeting.
meeting.next: Staff will bring the mass nomination flyer to the next meeting as a format for outreach to community associations. The investigative groups will meet on their own and report back at the next meeting. Staff will email the group members the outline.

moments.q: Vote to go into executive session
Update: Council passed the dissolution resolution on first reading
"We will be spinning our wheels showing up to the next meeting."
